api_base.description: The base URL of the LiteLLM API. Can also be set via the LITELLM_API_BASE environment variable.

api_key.description: The API key for authenticating with LiteLLM. Can also be set via the LITELLM_API_KEY environment variable.

insecure_skip_verify.description: Skip TLS certificate verification. Defaults to false.

litellm_changed_by.description: Value for the litellm-changed-by header to track actions performed by authorized users.

block.description: Terraform provider for managing LiteLLM resources.

access_group.description: The name of the access group.

id.description: The unique identifier for this access group (same as access_group name).

model_names.description: Non-empty list of model names (model_name from litellm_model) to include in this access group. Membership order and duplicate entries are not significant.

block.description: Manages a LiteLLM access group. Access groups allow you to group models together for access control on keys and teams.

created_at.description: Timestamp when the agent was created.

extra_headers.description: Extra header names to forward from the incoming request.

id.description: The agent ID (assigned by LiteLLM).

litellm_params.description: Legacy literal string-only LiteLLM parameters. Values are never parsed or coerced. Use litellm_params_json for heterogeneous values.

litellm_params_json.description: Lossless JSON-object bridge for arbitrary LiteLLM parameters. It merges with non-overlapping legacy map keys; overlapping values must be the identical JSON string value. Explicit configuration owns only its exact keys.

rpm_limit.description: Requests per minute limit for the agent.

static_headers.description: Static headers to send with agent requests. Marked sensitive because headers commonly contain authorization credentials.

tpm_limit.description: Tokens per minute limit for the agent.

updated_at.description: Timestamp when the agent was last updated.

updated_by.description: User who last updated the agent.

protocol_version.description: A2A protocol version string. LiteLLM serves the 0.3 and 1.0 protocol families; the registry field itself is not narrowed to a provider-defined enum.

supports_authenticated_extended_card.description: Whether the agent supports an authenticated extended A2A card.

url.description: The URL endpoint for the agent.

push_notifications.description: Whether the agent supports push notifications.

state_transition_history.description: Whether the agent supports state transition history.

streaming.description: Whether the agent supports streaming responses.

block.description: Capabilities supported by the agent.

organization.description: Organization name of the agent provider.

block.description: The service provider of the agent.

header.description: Optional arbitrary non-null JWS header as a JSON object. Conflicts with header_json.

header_json.description: Strict JSON bridge for an arbitrary JWS header, including explicit JSON null. Conflicts with header.

block.description: Ordered JWS signatures. Duplicate entries are preserved. An empty list explicitly clears signatures.

description.description: Description of what the skill does.

id.description: Unique identifier for the skill.

security.description: Ordered non-null A2A security requirements. Each map value is an ordered list of scopes; duplicates are preserved. Conflicts with security_json.

security_json.description: Strict JSON bridge for ordered A2A security requirements, including explicit JSON null. Conflicts with security.

block.description: Skills the agent can perform.
The A2A agent card — a self-describing manifest for the agent.

agents.description: Other agent IDs this agent can invoke.

mcp_access_groups.description: MCP access groups the agent belongs to.

mcp_servers.description: MCP server IDs the agent can access.

mcp_tool_permissions.description: Per-MCP-server tool permissions. The public type remains map(string): each value must be a JSON array containing only tool-name strings, such as jsonencode(["list_issues"]). Empty arrays and an empty map are valid explicit clears.

models.description: Model IDs the agent can use.

block.description: Access control permissions for the agent.
Manages a LiteLLM Agent (A2A). Agents are AI-powered entities that can be discovered, invoked, and composed using the Agent-to-Agent protocol.

budget_id.description: The unique budget ID. If not specified, one will be generated.

id.description: The unique identifier for this budget (same as budget_id).

max_budget.description: Max budget in USD. Requests will fail if this budget is exceeded.

max_parallel_requests.description: Max concurrent requests allowed for this budget.

model_max_budget.description: JSON object mapping model names to validated LiteLLM BudgetConfig objects. Supports canonical max_budget/budget_duration and budget_limit/time_period aliases.

rpm_limit.description: Max requests per minute allowed for this budget.

soft_budget.description: Soft budget in USD. Requests will NOT fail if exceeded, but will fire alerting.

tpm_limit.description: Max tokens per minute allowed for this budget.

block.description: Manages a LiteLLM budget. Budgets can be used to control spending limits for keys, teams, and organizations.

credential_info.description: Legacy string-only credential metadata. Its public map(string), Optional, and Computed contract is preserved. Use credential_info_json for heterogeneous values.

credential_info_json.description: Canonical JSON object for heterogeneous credential metadata. Legacy and JSON keys are merged; overlapping keys must have exactly equal values.

credential_name.description: Non-empty credential name. Empty names are rejected because LiteLLM can create them but cannot address them safely for refresh or deletion.

credential_source.description: Effective ownership source: credential_values, model_id, or imported.

credential_values.description: Legacy string-only sensitive credential values. Its map(string) type and state representation are preserved while the argument is now optional so model-only configuration and metadata-only import are representable. Use credential_values_json for heterogeneous values.

credential_values_active.description: Whether configured credential_values and credential_values_json were the active create source. False when model_id won or the resource was imported metadata-only.

credential_values_json.description: Canonical JSON object for heterogeneous sensitive credential values. Legacy and JSON keys are merged; overlapping keys must have exactly equal values.

id.description: The unique identifier for this credential (same as credential_name).

model_id.description: Create-only model deployment ID. LiteLLM uses it in preference to configured credential values. Any change, including an unknown planned value, requires replacement.

block.description: Manages a LiteLLM credential with recursive selective ownership and additive heterogeneous JSON surfaces.

fallback_models.description: List of fallback model names in order of priority.

fallback_type.description: Type of fallback: general (default), context_window, or content_policy.

id.description: Unique identifier for this fallback (model:fallback_type).

model.description: The model name to configure fallbacks for (e.g. 'gpt-3.5-turbo').

block.description: Manages a LiteLLM fallback configuration for a model. Fallbacks are used when a model call fails after retries.

created_at.description: Timestamp when the guardrail was created.

default_on.description: Whether the guardrail is enabled by default for all requests.

guardrail_id.description: The unique guardrail ID. Generated if not specified.

guardrail_info.description: JSON object string containing additional metadata for the guardrail.

id.description: The unique identifier for this guardrail (same as guardrail_id).

litellm_params.description: JSON object string containing additional provider-specific parameters for the guardrail.

mode.description: When to apply the guardrail. Accepts a mode string, a JSON string array, or a JSON Mode object with required tags and optional default routing.

block.description: Manages a LiteLLM guardrail. Guardrails provide content filtering, PII detection, prompt injection protection, and more.

created_at.description: Creation timestamp returned by LiteLLM.

description.description: Optional mapping description. Once configured on a provider-created or previously managed mapping, assigning null clears it. An imported omitted description remains API-owned until a non-null value is configured.

id.description: Authoritative LiteLLM mapping UUID and import identifier.

is_active.description: Whether LiteLLM uses the mapping. Omitted imported values remain API-owned; false is sent explicitly.

jwt_claim_name.description: JWT claim name. Immutable after creation; LiteLLM accepts the empty string.

jwt_claim_value.description: Sensitive JWT claim value to match. Immutable after creation; LiteLLM accepts the empty string.

key_wo.description: Raw existing LiteLLM virtual key. Sent only on create or immutable claim-pair replacement and never stored in plan or state. In-place rotation is rejected because LiteLLM v1.98 returns no verifiable token identity.

key_wo_version.description: Persisted create-time version marker for key_wo. Same-identity post-create changes are rejected; a known immutable claim-pair replacement permits a known non-empty marker with a known non-empty key. Unchanged historical values remain plannable.

updated_at.description: Last-update timestamp returned by LiteLLM.

block.description: Manages a LiteLLM JWT claim-to-virtual-key mapping. The raw virtual key is write-only and requires Terraform 1.11 or compatible OpenTofu support for create and claim-pair replacement. LiteLLM v1.98 does not expose evidence that could verify in-place key rotation.

budget_id.description: Budget ID to associate with this key.

config_json.description: Additional key configuration as a semantic JSON object.

enforced_params.description: List of enforced params for this key (params that must be present in requests).

id.description: Non-sensitive unique identifier for this key (SHA256 hash of the key value).

key.description: The API key value. If not specified, a key will be generated. Use key_wo instead to avoid storing a predefined key in Terraform artifacts.

key_alias.description: User-friendly alias for the key. When service_account_id is set and key_alias is omitted, the provider defaults key_alias to the service_account_id value.

key_wo.description: Write-only predefined API key value. Terraform sends this value to LiteLLM but does not store it in plan or state artifacts. Use a cryptographically random, high-entropy key because its persisted SHA256 management identifier permits offline guesses of weak values. Requires Terraform 1.11 or compatible OpenTofu support.

key_wo_version.description: Persisted version or nonce for key_wo. Change it when the write-only key changes; changing or removing it replaces the LiteLLM key.

metadata.description: Metadata for the key. Marked sensitive because values may contain API keys or other credentials.

metadata_json.description: Additional key metadata as a semantic JSON object.

models.description: List of models this key can access.

organization_id.description: Organization ID associated with this key.

permissions_json.description: Additional key permissions as a semantic JSON object.

project_id.description: Project ID associated with this key. When set, models and budget are validated against the project's limits.

prompts.description: List of prompt IDs this key can access.

allowed_fails.description: Failures allowed before a deployment enters cooldown.

context_window_fallbacks.description: Ordered JSON array of context-window fallback mappings.

fallbacks.description: Ordered JSON array of model fallback mappings.

model_group_affinity_config.description: JSON object mapping affinity groups to arrays of model groups.

model_group_alias.description: JSON object mapping aliases to model groups or alias configuration objects.

model_group_retry_policy.description: JSON object mapping model groups to retry-policy objects. Retry-policy keys use LiteLLM's PascalCase wire names.

retry_after.description: Retry delay in seconds; decimal values are supported.

retry_policy.description: Default retry counts by LiteLLM exception type.

routing_strategy_args.description: JSON object passed to the routing strategy.

router_settings.description: Key-specific LiteLLM v1.98.0 router settings. When configured, Terraform owns and replaces the complete router-settings document. Complex heterogeneous fields are JSON strings.

rpm_limit_type.description: RPM limit enforcement type. LiteLLM v1.98 accepts guaranteed_throughput, best_effort_throughput, or dynamic for keys.

send_invite_email.description: Create-only action flag that asks LiteLLM to asynchronously email the key's existing user. Requires user_id. It is write-only, is never sent during Update, and does not confirm delivery.

service_account_id.description: Service account ID for team-owned keys. LiteLLM v1.98 does not update this identity in place.

team_id.description: Team ID associated with this key.

tpm_limit_type.description: TPM limit enforcement type. LiteLLM v1.98 accepts guaranteed_throughput, best_effort_throughput, or dynamic for keys.

user_id.description: User ID associated with this key.

block.description: Manages a LiteLLM API key.

blocked.description: Whether the key is currently blocked. Always true when this resource exists.

id.description: Non-sensitive SHA256 management identifier for this block. The raw key is never used as the resource ID.

key.description: Legacy stateful API key input. Existing configurations remain supported; prefer key_hash for new resources.

key_hash.description: A sha256:<64-hex> key management identifier, such as litellm_key.example.id. LiteLLM receives only the bare hash.

block.description: Manages the blocked state of a LiteLLM API key. Creating this resource blocks the key; destroying it unblocks the key.

alias.description: Alias for the MCP server. LiteLLM normalizes ASCII spaces to underscores and defaults an omitted alias from server_name.

allow_all_keys.description: Whether to allow all API keys to access this MCP server.

allowed_tools.description: List of allowed tool names for this MCP server.

audience.description: Canonical OAuth audience used by RFC 8693 token exchange, ID-JAG, or OAuth2 client credentials.

auth_type.description: Authentication type accepted by the LiteLLM v1.98 MCP server request contract.

authorization_url.description: OAuth authorization URL for the MCP server.

available_on_public_internet.description: Whether the MCP server is available from the public internet. Removing configured ownership restores LiteLLM's durable true default.

command.description: Command to run for stdio transport.

created_at.description: Timestamp when the server was created.

credentials.description: Credentials map for the MCP server authentication.

dcr_bridge.description: Whether the dynamic client registration bridge is enabled.

delegate_auth_to_upstream.description: Whether LiteLLM delegates authentication to the upstream MCP server.

env.description: Environment variables for the command (stdio transport).

extra_headers.description: Extra header names to forward to the MCP server.

field_ownership_generation.description: Internal non-sensitive generation of presence-aware MCP field ownership intent.

id.description: The unique identifier for this MCP server (same as server_id).

instructions.description: Instructions associated with the MCP server. An empty string is a valid owned value.

is_byok.description: Whether this MCP server uses bring-your-own-key configuration.

issuer.description: OAuth issuer anchor. LiteLLM may mask this value by role; null or omission on read does not prove a clear.

max_concurrent_requests.description: Positive maximum number of concurrent requests.

mcp_access_groups.description: List of access groups for the MCP server.

mcp_info_clear_paths.description: Sensitive list of canonical RFC 6901 object-member pointers to clear. Root and array traversal are not supported.

mcp_info_json.description: Sensitive complete MCP info JSON object. The root must be a non-null object; {} explicitly owns and clears the whole document. Authoritative reads expose the complete object without dropping unknown members or exact JSON numbers.

mcp_info_overrides_json.description: Sensitive recursive selective MCP info JSON object. Nested null is data and a nested empty object atomically replaces that member.

mcp_info_ownership_generation.description: Internal non-sensitive generation of MCP info ownership intent.

oauth2_flow.description: OAuth2 flow stamped and returned by LiteLLM.

oauth_passthrough.description: Whether OAuth Authorization headers are passed through to the upstream MCP server.

oauth_scopes.description: Sensitive write-only OAuth scopes stored natively at credentials.scopes. LiteLLM v1.98 management reads never expose this value.

registration_url.description: OAuth registration URL for the MCP server.

server_id.description: Create-only unique identifier for the MCP server. When omitted, the provider selects a stable generated identifier.

server_name.description: Optional name of the MCP server. When name and alias are omitted, LiteLLM uses server_id as the tool-prefix fallback.

skip_url_validation.description: Deprecated compatibility attribute. LiteLLM v1.98 does not accept this field; new or changed true values are unsafe, while unchanged historical state remains plannable.

source_url.description: Source URL associated with the MCP server.

spec_path.description: Path or URL of an OpenAPI specification. For HTTP and SSE transports this can be used instead of url.

spec_version.description: Deprecated compatibility attribute. LiteLLM v1.98 does not accept or return this field.

static_headers.description: Static headers to always include with requests.

token_exchange_endpoint.description: Canonical OAuth token-exchange endpoint. The legacy credentials key remains accepted as an alternative source, but the two sources cannot be configured together.

token_url.description: OAuth token URL for the MCP server.

tool_name_to_description.description: Tool-name description overrides. Values are arbitrary strings and an empty map clears all overrides.

tool_name_to_display_name.description: Tool-name display overrides. Empty values and an empty map are valid.

transport.description: Transport type for the MCP server (http, sse, stdio).

updated_at.description: Timestamp when the server was last updated.

updated_by.description: User who last updated the server.

url.description: URL of the MCP server. HTTP and SSE transports require url or spec_path; stdio does not require a URL.

logo_url.description: Logo URL for the MCP server.

tool_name_to_cost_per_query.description: Map of tool names to their cost per query.

block.description: Cost information for MCP server tools.
MCP server information and configuration.
Manages a LiteLLM MCP (Model Context Protocol) server.

access_groups.description: List of access groups this model belongs to. Teams and keys with access to these groups can use this model.

additional_litellm_params.description: Additional parameters to pass to litellm_params. Removing configured keys replaces the model so LiteLLM cannot silently retain them.

additional_litellm_params_configured.description: Internal state marker indicating whether additional_litellm_params is explicitly managed by configuration.

additional_litellm_params_json.description: Sensitive lossless JSON-object sibling for heterogeneous litellm_params. Keys cannot overlap additional_litellm_params, dedicated model attributes, credentials removed by /model/info, or model-budget fields. Any change replaces the model so LiteLLM cannot retain removed nested values.

additional_model_info.description: Additional fields to store in model_info, e.g. capability flags (supports_vision, supports_function_calling, supports_reasoning, …) for models missing from LiteLLM's model cost map. Values are strings and are converted to native JSON types (int, float, bool, JSON) for the API. Only keys configured here are managed; fields LiteLLM derives from its model cost map are left alone.

additional_model_info_configured.description: Internal state marker indicating whether additional_model_info is explicitly managed by configuration.

additional_model_info_json.description: Sensitive lossless JSON-object sibling for heterogeneous model_info fields. Keys cannot overlap additional_model_info or fields managed by dedicated attributes. Any change replaces the model so LiteLLM cannot retain removed nested values.

aws_access_key_id.description: AWS access key ID for Bedrock.

aws_secret_access_key.description: AWS secret access key for Bedrock.

base_model.description: The base model name from the provider.

custom_llm_provider.description: The LLM provider (e.g., openai, anthropic, bedrock).

id.description: The unique identifier for this model.

litellm_credential_name.description: Name of the credential to use for this model. References a credential created via litellm_credential resource.

mode.description: Model mode. Supported values: chat, completion, embedding, audio_speech, audio_transcription, image_generation, video_generation, batch, rerank, realtime, responses, ocr, moderation.

model_api_base.description: Base URL for the model API.

model_api_key.description: API key for the model provider.

model_name.description: The name of the model as it will appear in LiteLLM.

team_id.description: Team ID to associate with this model.

vertex_credentials.description: Google Cloud credentials for Vertex AI.

vertex_location.description: Google Cloud location for Vertex AI.

vertex_project.description: Google Cloud project for Vertex AI.

block.description: Manages a LiteLLM model deployment.

blocked.description: Deprecated compatibility field. LiteLLM v1.98 has no persistent organization blocked column; false is accepted as a no-op and true is rejected.

budget_id.description: The ID for the organization's budget. Reassociating an existing organization is not supported safely by LiteLLM v1.98.

created_at.description: Timestamp when the organization was created.

id.description: The unique identifier for this organization (same as organization_id).

max_budget.description: Maximum hard budget for the organization.

max_parallel_requests.description: Maximum parallel requests for the organization budget.

metadata_json.description: Additional organization metadata as a semantic JSON object.

model_rpm_limit.description: The RPM limit per model. Updated through v1.98's transactional complete-metadata replacement so owned keys can clear safely.

model_tpm_limit.description: The TPM limit per model. Updated through v1.98's transactional complete-metadata replacement so owned keys can clear safely.

models.description: The models the organization has access to.

organization_id.description: The organization ID. If not specified, one will be generated.

rpm_limit.description: Maximum requests per minute for the organization.

soft_budget.description: Soft budget alert threshold for the organization.

tags.description: Deprecated compatibility field. LiteLLM v1.98 has no persistent organization tags column; an empty list is accepted as a no-op and non-empty values are rejected.

tpm_limit.description: Maximum tokens per minute for the organization.

block.description: Manages a LiteLLM organization. Budget controls are read authoritatively from LiteLLM v1.98's nested litellm_budget_table relation.

id.description: Canonical membership identifier in organization_id:user_id form.

max_budget_in_organization.description: Maximum spend for this user within the organization. LiteLLM v1.98.0 can set or change this value but cannot clear it in place; removing a previously configured value replaces the membership.

role.description: The member's organization role. LiteLLM v1.98.0 accepts org_admin, internal_user, or internal_user_viewer.

user_email.description: The user email used to resolve or create a user. Either user_id or user_email must be provided. This resource does not manage the user's email after LiteLLM resolves a user_id.

user_id.description: The user ID to add. Either user_id or user_email must be provided. When both are set, LiteLLM first looks up user_id and falls back to an existing user_email if that ID does not exist. Email-resolved creates are stored with the canonical user_id returned by LiteLLM.

block.description: Manages a member of a LiteLLM organization. If the user does not exist, LiteLLM creates it as part of adding the membership.

blocked.description: Whether the project is blocked from making requests.

budget_id.description: Budget ID associated with this project. Reassociation is not safely supported by LiteLLM v1.98.

created_at.description: Timestamp when the project was created.

description.description: Description of the project's purpose and use case.

id.description: The unique project ID (assigned by LiteLLM).

metadata.description: Metadata for the project. Values are strings; use jsonencode() for complex values.

metadata_json.description: Additional project metadata as a semantic JSON object.

model_max_budget.description: Legacy per-model budget map shape retained for schema compatibility.

model_rpm_limit.description: Per-model RPM limits stored in project metadata.

model_tpm_limit.description: Per-model TPM limits stored in project metadata.

models.description: List of models the project can access.

tags.description: Tags associated with the project. LiteLLM v1.98 stores these in project metadata.

team_id.description: The team ID that this project belongs to.

updated_at.description: Timestamp when the project was last updated.

updated_by.description: User who last updated the project.

block.description: Manages a LiteLLM Project. Project budget controls are read authoritatively from the nested litellm_budget_table relation.

created_at.description: Creation timestamp of the selected latest version.

dotprompt_content.description: Content for dotprompt integration (Firebase Genkit format).

environment.description: Environment-scoped prompt identity. Defaults to development; changing it creates a separately owned logical prompt.

ignore_prompt_manager_model.description: If true, ignore the model specified in the prompt manager.

prompt_type.description: Type of prompt: config or db.

provider_specific_query_params.description: JSON object string of provider-specific query parameters.

updated_at.description: Last-update timestamp of the selected latest version.

version.description: Latest version currently owned in this environment. Updates append a new version.

max_retries.description: Maximum number of retries for failed requests.

search_tool_id.description: Unique identifier for the search tool.

budget_id.description: Budget ID associated with this tag. LiteLLM v1.98 cannot safely detach or reassign an existing association.

max_budget.description: Max budget in USD for this tag.

max_parallel_requests.description: Max concurrent requests allowed for this tag.

model_max_budget.description: JSON object of per-model GenericBudgetConfig values.

name.description: The unique name of the tag.

rpm_limit.description: Max requests per minute for this tag.

soft_budget.description: Soft budget in USD for this tag.

tpm_limit.description: Max tokens per minute for this tag.

access_group_ids.description: Access group IDs associated with this team. Order is ignored. Set an empty collection to detach all access groups.

budget_duration.description: Recurring team budget reset interval. Accepts positive s, m, h, d, or w durations; hourly, daily, weekly, or monthly; or exactly 1mo.

id.description: The unique identifier for this team.

metadata_json.description: Additional team metadata as a semantic JSON object.

model_aliases.description: Model alias mappings for the team.

model_rpm_limit.description: Per-model RPM limits for the team.

model_tpm_limit.description: Per-model TPM limits for the team.

models.description: List of models the team can access.

prompts.description: List of prompt IDs the team can access.

fallback_models.description: Ordered list of fallback model names.

model.description: The primary model name to configure fallbacks for.

context_window_fallbacks.description: Fallback model chains triggered when a context window exceeded error occurs.

fallback_models.description: Ordered list of fallback model names.

model.description: The primary model name to configure fallbacks for.

fallbacks.description: Fallback model chains triggered when a model call fails after retries.

block.description: Manages a LiteLLM team.

blocked.description: Whether the team is currently blocked. Always true when this resource exists.

id.description: The unique identifier for this block (same as team_id).

role.description: Role in the team (admin or user).

team_id.description: Team ID. Changing it replaces the membership.

user_id.description: Canonical user ID. Either user_id or user_email must be provided. Email-only creates store LiteLLM's resolved canonical ID in state. Changing a configured canonical ID replaces the membership.

block.description: Manages a single LiteLLM team member by an immutable canonical user identity.
